name: opening-impulse-forward-engineering-v1
strategy: Unchanged opening-impulse engineering rule: require all 15 positive-volume minute bars from 09:30 through 09:44 New York. At completion of 09:44, buy if close exceeds 09:30 open, sell if lower, otherwise skip. At most one entry per New York date, one contract; fixed 80-tick simulated stop. Reduce-only exit from completion of 10:14. No LLM, target, trailing stop or adaptive parameters.
execution: Internal OHLCV simulation, not broker paper execution. Orders are durable before submission. Eligible at a minute open at least one full minute after the signal bar completes AND after its actual arrival/decision time; arrivals that miss eligibility cannot receive a retrospective fill. One adverse tick and $0.62 commission per side. Stops use the adverse opening gap or stop plus slippage. A minute-based simulation cannot establish queue, quote or exchange-held protection realism.
economic_hurdle: Operational experiment only. Report all baseline and worse-cost results; no alpha verdict, annualized return, income claim or live-pilot promotion. Before any efficacy evaluation, freeze a separate economic hurdle, search history and dependence-aware inference plan.
data_access_record: At registration, persist UTC start time, template digest, exact code hashes and preflight-access provenance before connecting. Only subsequently arriving bars with intervals starting after registration are eligible. No subscription replay, historical backfill, old account import or reset. Duplicate receipts retain original timing; late data is recorded and excluded, with an affected-session halt.
contract_policy: Resolve each provider instrument ID to its dated raw contract from SymbolMappingMsg. Never execute a continuous symbol. Pin one actual contract per UTC mapping segment. On a mapping change, halt entries for the affected New York date, cancel unfilled entries, and switch only if both baseline and stress accounts are flat with no pending orders. A roll with exposure hard-halts for review; never transfer an open lot across contracts.
failure_policy: Persist each event before processing and recover the unfinished event after a crash. A disconnect, heartbeat timeout, stale bar, unexplained gap, missing mapping or invalid data suppresses new entries for the affected day. Cancel outstanding entry orders before a post-gap market event. Existing inventory remains in the ledger; no fabricated fills through a data outage. On return, process fresh eligible events and explicitly record the gap. Retry a terminal rejected, cancelled or expired reduce-only exit while inventory remains; each retry has a new durable identifier. Unexplained accounting, changed code/protocol or a roll with inventory hard-halts. Risk caps are entry/exit triggers, not guaranteed maximum losses through gaps.
stopping_rule: Run continuously under supervision until explicitly stopped or a hard halt occurs. At daily close reconcile both scenarios independently, including open inventory and unresolved orders. Count complete and excluded opening opportunities; do not promote based on calendar duration. Retain every outage, rejection, partial day and scenario. Twenty complete opening opportunities trigger an engineering review, not automatic strategy validation or scaling.
publication: Publish aggregate simulated account values and operational status only. No licensed bars, market prices, keys, account identifiers or order controls in the public partner workspace.
limits: This version completes a streaming-fed internal paper service. It does not complete an external futures broker adapter, guarantee continuous operation while the host sleeps, establish profitability or satisfy the six live-pilot requirements. Budget for new services: at most $100/month; no Databento plan changes or automatic upgrades.
